trailhead.label: The panoramic boardwalk by the lake at Passo Lavazè, the sheet’s start

cautions: The car park is by the SS620 at the pass: keep your dog on a short lead there.
Cows graze the Lavazè pastures in summer, with a wooden cattle gate on the way: keep a short lead, give them room and close the gate.
Deutschnofen allows no dogs on farmed meadows: keep your dog on the track.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The car park is by the SS620 at the pass: Il parcheggio è lungo la SS620 al passo: lì tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Cows graze the Lavazè pastures in summer: D’estate le mucche pascolano sui prati del Lavazè, e lungo la via c’è un cancello in legno per il bestiame: guinzaglio corto, lascia loro spazio e richiudi il cancello.
textIt.Deutschnofen allows no dogs on farmed me: Nova Ponente non ammette cani sui prati coltivati: tieni il cane sulla strada.
